notes: Zombies move and attack in more varied ways: new idle, walk, run, attack, flinch and fall animations, with variants picked per zombie, so a crowd no longer moves in step.
A zombie's attack is timed to its swing: the blow lands as its arms or teeth reach you, so stepping back at the right moment works.
Crawlers: some infected have lost the use of their legs. They drag themselves along the ground and bite at your ankles. They are slow; aim low.
The Brute: a rare, big and much tougher infected, found outdoors only. Slow, but its blows open deep wounds. You hear its heavy steps before you see it.
Voice does not work yet for players who join by typing an IP address.
In the Haldersfield house P05, the far end of the attic is very dark at dusk.
The upper floor of house P04 has not been checked yet.
The difficulty presets are only partly connected to the game.
The notice about sending statistics is only in Settings, not shown at first start.
The speed check (against cheating) has not been tested under real lag.
